I changed `render()` in `logline/render.py` to match the README, but I could not run the tests. Bash is denied in this session, so `bb-test` did not run.

The function now uppercases the level, pads it to 5 characters, and escapes newlines in the message using `escape_newlines` from `logline/text.py`. By hand, `render("info", "db", "started")` gives `INFO  | db | started`, which matches the existing test in `tests/test_render.py`.

To verify, run `bb-test` in this directory, or allow Bash and I'll run it.
